approval.notes: Forge weapon set (R-1754). Glued boards, faced and painted; Kalev rivets the strap fittings. Heater shields belong to the knightly kit of the 1340s.

uses: Equip in the left hand: guarding costs far less stamina and the parry window widens.
Keeps the right hand free for sword, axe, hammer or spear.

source_notes.summary: The heater shield is part of the Order knight's kit in 1343; a burgher could own an older one.
